description: This file defines the NetworkFlowMonitorClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Network Flow Monitor service, including creating, deleting, retrieving, and managing monitors and scopes, as well as querying and tagging resources.

classes.name: NetworkFlowMonitorClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Network Flow Monitor service, extending AwsClient.

methods.description: Creates a new network flow monitor.
